_note: The daily specials, a day per entry, written a week ahead. This file is the contract: /menu's 'Today's special' box, the weekly Facebook post (src/studio/fb-weekly-specials.njk, with its caption), the counter sign, and /specials.json are all built from it. /specials.json is what the kitchen PC reads (kitchen/README.md, Specials): each morning it puts that day's plate and soup into Square by itself. Change the shape and all of them change.
_note_fields: `date` is YYYY-MM-DD and is the ONLY date — weekday names and 'October 5' are computed from it, so a day can never be labelled wrong. `soup` is the soup of the day (it starts at 11am; prices are Cup/Bowl on the menu). `special` is the plate and `sides` what comes with it. `price` on a day is that plate's price when it isn't the usual one (the top-level `price`); see _note_price. `photo` is reserved for later — a path under /assets/ once there are food photos; nothing reads it yet.
_note_weeks: ADD next week; don't replace this one. Next week goes in a week ahead (for the Facebook post) while this week is still on /menu, so the file holds both side by side. /menu lists one week at a time by the visitor's date; the Facebook post, its caption and the counter sign show the NEWEST week in the file (the latestWeek filter). Delete a week once it's over (copy it to SPECIALS-HISTORY.md in the private CafeWork repo first), or leave it: a past day is never shown.
_note_kitchen: The kitchen PC reads /specials.json every half hour and never changes today once it has put today into Square (first thing when it starts, or at midnight), an earlier day, or a day set on its own front page (Manage > Specials) from it. So adding next week, or fixing a later day here, can't disturb today's specials in Square; a change to tomorrow made here before the PC starts goes in, but fixing TODAY once the cafe is open has to be done on the front page. The one exception is today's `sides`: a fix here reaches Square's side lists within half an hour or at the kitchen PC's Check for updates (client 2026-10-19).
_note_expiry: Nothing here expires by itself, and nothing has to: /menu picks today's entry in the visitor's browser on Central time and shows nothing at all on a day that is not listed — weekends, and every day after the last one. An old week left in place is therefore hidden, never shown.
_note_any_side: `anySide: true` on a day means the plate comes with the customer's choice of any Deli Salad (the `choices` of that row in menu.json, cottage cheese among them; not chips or fruit), included in the price, picked in Square from Lunch Special's Side 1 list (Chef's Choice unless the customer picks); every piece then says 'with choice of side' instead of naming sides, and the weekly post lists the choices once, under the week. The same sides can be swapped in for the set sides on any other special (client 2026-10-09); that is done at the counter, so the post says so but nothing here records it. Not every special has it: a day with set sides (Chicken Fried Chicken with mashed potatoes, white gravy and green beans) lists them in `sides` and leaves anySide off. Don't set both. The kitchen also picks a side of its own for an anySide day from what's in the shop (client 2026-10-14), usually decided only the day before: once it is known, swap that day's anySide for `sides: ['<that side>']` (Cheesy Potatoes on 2026-10-15), so Square has it picked already and the customer can still swap it for a Deli Salad or the soup. The words are built in one place, the specialSides filter (src/_lib/specials-caption.js).
_note_square_sides: Each entry in `sides` becomes a side list on Lunch Special in Square (Side 1, Side 2, Side 3), written by the kitchen PC each morning: the side picked already, then the Deli Salads to swap it for. Write a side the customer picks as ONE entry with 'or' between ('Tossed Salad or Cooked Broccoli'): Square then offers both, nothing picked, so the customer or the counter picks one (no Chef's Choice since client 2026-10-29), then the swap sides; the Special Side offers both too. Two entries are two sides on the plate. The words read the same everywhere else (client 2026-10-11). kitchen/README.md, 'Sides in Square'.
_note_drink: `includesDrink: true` here, at the top of the file, means EVERY lunch special includes a drink: a fountain drink or iced tea (client 2026-10-08). It started midweek on 2026-10-07; the days before that didn't include one. The weekly post, the counter sign, the caption and the /menu box all say so, as just 'a drink' (client 2026-10-08: keep Facebook text simple, explain at the counter). The soup is NOT part of the special: it is its own item (Cup / Bowl, priced in menu.json), and every piece shows it apart from the plate.
_note_soup_side: `soupSide: true` here, at the top of the file, means a cup of the day's soup can be picked as a side on EVERY lunch special, at no charge, like the Deli Salads (client 2026-10-13). The kitchen PC adds 'Soup of the Day' to the end of Lunch Special's side lists in Square, and the weekly post, its caption and the day sign list it with the swap sides. The soup on its own is still its own item.
_note_extra_sides: `extraSides` on a day adds sides to that day's swap list only, ahead of the Deli Salads, and to the Special Side ('just for today': Oven Browned Potatoes on 2026-10-13, client; the Special Side since 2026-10-29). Nothing else shows them; they only add choices in Square. They can also be typed on the kitchen PC's front page (Manage > Specials, Extra sides today). Unlike the rest of a day, the kitchen PC takes them even for today once it's in Square, so adding one this morning reaches Square within half an hour (or at Check for updates).
_note_counter_only: `counterOnly` on a day lists sides sold at the counter only that day, hidden from online ordering: ["Twice Baked Potato Casserole"] on 2026-10-29, yesterday's, sold off until it runs out (client). Write each exactly as in `sides` or `extraSides`. The kitchen PC hides those options online on Lunch Special's side lists and the Special Side (Square's 'Hide on Square Online'), keeps them on the till, and leaves them out of Lunch Special's description. Read like extraSides: even for today once it's in Square, within half an hour or at Check for updates. The website, the posts and the signs still name the side. kitchen/README.md, 'Sides in Square'.
_note_modifiers: `modifiers` on a day are that plate's Specials Modifiers: options typed as they should read on the ticket, free unless ending in a price: ["Add Mayo", "Extra Cheese +$1"] (client 2026-10-29). The kitchen PC puts them, after any `leaveOff`, in the 'Specials Modifiers' list on Lunch Special that morning, pick any; read even for today, like extraSides. Typing them on the kitchen PC's front page (Manage > Specials) wins over these for that day. Nothing else shows them. kitchen/README.md, 'Specials Modifiers'.
_note_leave_off: `leaveOff` on a day lists what a customer can have left off that plate, a word each: ["Bacon"] on the Chicken Bacon Avocado Wrap (client 2026-10-18). The kitchen PC puts them first in the 'Specials Modifiers' list on Lunch Special that morning (a 'Leave Off' list of their own until 2026-10-29), pick any, $0, worded 'No Bacon', so the ticket says so; on a day without any the list is off. Like extraSides it is read even for today once it's in Square. Nothing else shows it: the post and the signs don't. Plan one with each week's specials whenever a plate has something people often ask to leave off. kitchen/README.md, 'Leave Off'.
_note_price: `price` here, at the top of the file, is what EVERY lunch special costs unless its day sets its own `price` (client 2026-10-12: $10 unless otherwise described). The kitchen PC puts it into Square with the day's plate each morning, so this file is now where the price is set: change it here, not on the till. The weekly Facebook post shows it once at the top, and a day's own price beside that plate. The soup's Cup / Bowl prices stay in menu.json.
